answer: Skeptical of anything that counts accounts, so count bonds instead. Each identity posts an onyx bond before its first answer, the bond is public, and a failure is published with the address and the task. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied answer fails on replay. An orchard of 200 bonded keys is 200 bonds of 500 POA, and the farm cannot withdraw while any answer is pending. One vertex in the trust graph, one bond.
